title: AlgoGens Library: a dataset of systems where generative models propose and algorithms judge
description:
The AlgoGens Library lists published systems in which a generative model proposes candidates, an algorithm or another authority (a proof assistant, a verifier, a simulator, an evaluator) judges them, and the judgment steers the next proposals. Each card records the loop, the headline result as stated in its primary source, what the result does not prove, a classification along fixed fields, and the sources checked. The dataset also lists installable open-source tools built on the same pattern.

Browse it at algogens.org/library.
